Jason Donovan is full-on camp-tastic as Pharaoh in golden loincloth and sparkly trainers. The choreography (JoAnn M Hunter) feels wooden at times...but there is no denying that, as a whole, this Joseph has mojo.
Laurence Connor’s buoyant revival of Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice’s Biblical musical charmed audiences back in 2019, and remains an absolute winner.

cn.t: This buoyant, exuberant revival of Lloyd Webber and Rice's biblical musical charmer wins over critics with its colorful energy and polished choreography, proving the show remains an absolute crowd-pleaser decades after its debut.
